findings.title: CountAvailable indexes one past the end
findings.detail: The loop uses i <= len(items), so the last iteration reads items[len(items)], out of bounds.

findings.title: WriteReport swallows os.Create's error
findings.detail: The error from os.Create is discarded with the blank identifier, so a failed create surfaces only a nil-pointer failure later, never the real cause.
findings.risk_rationale: The report silently fails to write with a confusing error in place of the real one.

summary: Two independent bugs: an off-by-one loop and a swallowed error.
